title: Group-action divisibility (S3 ⟹ 6|M, parity ⟹ even-pair-count, dilation ⟹ ord|#bad) is a shared 'symmetry kills the count' principle linking e2=0 (F12) to the energy kernel (F5) with NO magnitude bound
